purpose: Independent verification of Obaid's 2026-09-02 Phase 3 development-complete claim on the production portal. Read-only, unauthenticated probes only.

claimUnderTest.author: Obaidullah Shaikh
claimUnderTest.claim: Phase 3 is complete from the development side. Everything is live and verified on production at vaclaims-portal.vercel.app.

findings: All eleven production routes named in the Phase 3 completion claim are reachable and return 200.
Every protected API route tested rejects unauthenticated requests with 401, consistent with the security patch confirmed on 2026-08-31.
The staff intake route /dashboard/clients/new is live, which is the capability that was missing when client intake was raised on 2026-09-01.
Operational surfaces are nested under /dashboard/*, not at the site root. An earlier probe of root-level paths returned 404; that was an incorrect path assumption by the reviewer, not a defect.
limitations: Unauthenticated verification only. Authenticated behaviour behind login was not exercised: stage transitions, onus toggle, stop clock, note append, advisor CRUD, and AI assistant responses are unverified from this session.
The vaclaims-dev/vace-platform repository is not attached to this session, so no code-level review of the Phase 3 backend was performed.
The daily cron job and Resend notification engine were not observed running; both are reported complete by Obaid but are not externally observable.
openItemsRequiringDavid: Confirm the Resend sender domain, most likely vaclaimsedge.com, so the daily alert engine can leave test-sender mode.
Confirm whether website self-registration is in scope for a later phase. Staff intake is live now; James Frederick asked for both self and staff onboarding on 2026-09-01.
